# FPSOT documentation specification

> How FPSOT specifications are documented, organized and published: repository files, page types, comparison by jurisdiction, outside sources, versions and outputs.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts and conformance.
- [Repository files](spec/en/repository.adoc): DOC-001 to DOC-003.
- [Pages](spec/en/pages.adoc): DOC-010, DOC-011, DOC-030, DOC-040, DOC-046.
- [Organization by jurisdiction](spec/en/organisation.adoc): DOC-020 to DOC-026.
- [Outside sources](spec/en/sources.adoc): DOC-025, DOC-043, DOC-044.
- [Versions and history](spec/en/versions.adoc): DOC-031 to DOC-033.
- [Outputs](spec/en/outputs.adoc): DOC-041, DOC-042, DOC-045.
